name: Algo Phantoms
tagline: Practice coding problems and learn data structures on your phone
description:
Algo Phantoms is a companion app for anyone learning data structures and algorithms. It includes a built-in code editor along with guided pathways and quizzes, so you can practice writing and testing code without needing a laptop nearby.

It's aimed at beginners who want a friendly, structured way to build up their problem-solving skills over time.
